summary: BCE Inc. and Bell Canada filed a Form 6-K furnished under the Exchange Act, reporting a debt underwriting agreement for Bell Canada to issue US$650 million 5.450% Series US-11 Notes due 2036, guaranteed by BCE. The notes are being sold to underwriters led by BofA Securities, Citigroup, RBC Capital Markets, and Wells Fargo. The filing includes the underwriting agreement and a tax opinion. This is a routine debt offering not constituting a special situation; the registrant is acting as issuer. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or activist campaign is present.
